response.rationale: History of cervical carcinoma with a new vaginal wall mass and no distant metastases favors local recurrence over de novo vaginal cancer; lymphoma is less supported by the anatomical origin and negative tumor markers.

rejected.why: Mass origin from vaginal wall and mesenteric nodes without distant metastases are less typical for primary GI lymphoma; negative tumor markers do not exclude but anatomy favors gynecologic recurrence.
